name: attach
description: Open a script channel to one page: a single-web window this connection opened (webWindowId) or a tab in this Nexus window (tabId) — exactly one of the two. The channel runs in a private world of the page; `exposeToPage` also lets the page's own scripts message the opener. Returns { channelId }. Events onMessage / onDetached carry the channelId.

inputs.name: webWindowId
inputs.description: A single-web window this connection opened (webWindow.open).

inputs.name: tabId
inputs.description: A tab in this Nexus window, by the id its tab list publishes.

inputs.name: exposeToPage
inputs.description: Also give the page's own scripts the messaging object. Absent: false.
